newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures end with strong gains.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures end with strong gains.

text.p: Dec 27 - U.S. debt futures closed with stronger gains and near the highs of the session. Weaker than expected November U.S. durable goods orders contributed to strength in the bond market early, sending March above resistance at 113-20/32. However, volume quickly subsided and prices stayed in narrow ranges.
